import re,os
t=open('products/research/shopify-product-csv-official.txt',encoding='utf-8').read()
keys=['Image Src','Image Position','Variant Image','Variant Barcode','Option1 name','Option1 value','Option2','URL handle','Variant SKU','Image Alt','15 MB','first row','Product image URL','Variant image URL','Barcode','Image position']
out=[]
for k in keys:
  for m in list(re.finditer(re.escape(k),t,re.I))[:2]:
    s=max(0,m.start()-150); out.append(f'== {k} @{m.start()}: '+t[s:m.end()+400])
r='\n'.join(out)
os.makedirs('products/services/shopify-large-catalogue',exist_ok=True)
open('products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/doc-extract.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(r)
print(r[:30000])
